newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian lev falls to 200 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian lev falls to 200 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev fell to around 200 per dollar in thin trade on Monday from 199.30/60 at the close of the interbank forex market on Friday, dealers said.
Traders said they expected the lev to weaken to 200.50 per dollar today if dollar demand persisted in its current volumes due to the market's low liquidity.
"The shortage of dollars in the market will continue to pressure the lev," another dealer said.
Dealers said they expected the central bank to step in the market to support the lev if it went beyond 200.50 to the dollar.
